reason: The decomposition captures the intended creative-microscoping proof and all nine lemmas are individually plausible; L3 and especially L5 are the explicit bottlenecks. The main issues are formal rather than mathematical: step A7 is mislabeled as trivial, and step A9 applies the Laurent-polynomial cancellation lemma L9 to H=T_{d,r,n}(q)-R_{d,r,n}(q) without showing H is Laurent (the displayed theorem sum is generally a rational function with denominator built from U_{d,n}). The final cancellation therefore needs a localization/rational-function version of L9 or an explicit ambient-ring definition for the congruence.
